description.en: End time of the data range. Must be later than StartTime. Use ISO 8601 notation in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

description.zh:

description.en: Start time of the data range. Use ISO 8601 notation in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. Minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If you omit this parameter, the API returns data from the last 24 hours.
